title: Oil shock -> airlines lag
mechanism: Jet fuel is 20-30% of airline cost and hedges are partial; if investors under-react to an oil shock, airlines keep falling (rising) the session after a large oil rise (fall).
precursor: WTI front-month (CL=F) close-to-close change at close t beyond 2 trailing 63-session sd
separation_from_beta: the same-day response is ordinary oil beta and is printed separately; the test is the open t+1 -> close t+h residual after the basket's SPY beta (design-fold estimate)
refutation: confirm-fold (2023-26) mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Yield spike -> regional banks lag
mechanism: A 10-year yield spike raises unrealised securities losses and deposit costs; if the market under-reacts, regional banks keep falling the next session.
precursor: ^TNX close-to-close change at close t beyond 2 trailing 63-session sd
separation_from_beta: same-day response printed apart; the lag residual after SPY beta is the test
refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Yield spike -> utilities lag
mechanism: Utilities are bond proxies; a yield spike lowers their fair value and slow money keeps selling the next session.
precursor: ^TNX change at close t beyond 2 trailing sd
separation_from_beta: same-day beta printed apart; lag residual after SPY beta
refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Yield spike -> homebuilders lag
mechanism: Mortgage rates follow the 10-year; homebuilders' demand falls with them and the repricing takes more than a session.
precursor: ^TNX change at close t beyond 2 trailing sd
separation_from_beta: same-day beta printed apart; lag residual after SPY beta
refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: AI leader shock -> semi equipment lag
mechanism: A large move in the AI-chip leaders changes expected foundry and tool orders; suppliers (equipment, foundry) catch up over the next sessions.
precursor: equal-weight NVDA/AVGO/AMD close-to-close move at close t beyond 2 trailing sd
separation_from_beta: same-day co-move (sector beta) printed apart; lag residual after SPY beta
refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Oil shock -> refiners and chemicals (input cost) lag
mechanism: Crude is an input for chemicals and some refiners; margins compress after a spike and the market reprices over days.
precursor: CL=F change at close t beyond 2 trailing sd
separation_from_beta: same-day beta printed apart; lag residual after SPY beta
refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Earnings shock read-through to text-linked names (next-session size)
mechanism: When a large customer or supplier reports a big surprise, names that the news already links to it reprice; if the diffusion is slow, their next-session move exceeds their own volatility.
precursor: a source cell typed earnings_report by the student with |x_oc| >= 2x its trailing vol, and names co-mentioned with it in documents known at least a day before
separation_from_beta: vol-matched unlinked names on the same date are the control; the 252-session correlation peers (factor beta) run as their own cell for comparison
refutation: confirm-fold (2026) linked-minus-control log size ratio at t+1 <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Earnings shock read-through to correlation peers (factor-beta control)
mechanism: Names that co-move with the source (a factor-beta link) inherit part of its surprise on the next session if the factor reprices slowly.
precursor: the same source events; links = the top-5 252-session return-correlation peers as of t-1
separation_from_beta: this IS the beta link: it is the comparison for the text-link cell
refutation: confirm-fold linked-minus-control log size ratio at t+1 <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Abnormal attention predicts move size beyond priors and TF-IDF
mechanism: A name covered far more than its own normal attracts more traders and a larger move than its trailing vol and its words imply.
precursor: documents in the cell vs the symbol's mean daily document count over the previous 60 days; distinct sources in the 5 days before
separation_from_beta: the base is trailing vol + news counts + TF-IDF (T2); the increment is paired per date
refutation: confirm-fold (2026 test block) paired IC increment over T2 <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect

title: Supplier shock passes through to customer margin expectations
mechanism: When a key supplier reports an unexpected margin squeeze or cost inflation, its downstream customers face higher input costs that the market may not have priced into their earnings expectations yet, causing customer stocks to drift down over subsequent sessions.
precursor: A supplier's earnings report discloses gross margin decline >200bps QoQ or explicit cost inflation guidance, publicly before market open on t+1.
separation_from_beta: Compare customer basket return to a matched set of firms in the same sector with no identifiable supplier link, controlling for market beta and sector ETF return.
refutation: If linked customers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to matched unlinked firms in the same sector over t+1 to t+5, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Peer analyst downgrade spills over to thinly covered rivals
mechanism: When an analyst downgrades a well-covered firm citing industry headwinds, investors extrapolate the thesis to less-covered peers with similar exposure, but the information diffuses slowly to those names due to lower attention.
precursor: A prominent analyst downgrade of a large-cap firm in a sector, with explicit industry-wide reasoning, published before market open.
separation_from_beta: Compare returns of thinly covered peers to those of well-covered peers in the same sector, controlling for market and sector returns; the effect should be stronger for low-coverage names.
refutation: If thinly covered peers show no differential negative return compared to well-covered peers after the downgrade, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Commodity input shock hits downstream specialty chemical margins
mechanism: A sharp rise in a key commodity (e.g., natural gas) increases input costs for specialty chemical firms that cannot immediately pass through costs, leading to margin compression and negative returns for those firms.
precursor: Daily close-to-close change in the commodity futures price exceeds 2 standard deviations of its trailing 60-day volatility.
separation_from_beta: Compare the target basket's return to its historical beta-adjusted market return and to a basket of chemical firms with hedged or alternative inputs.
refutation: If the target basket does not underperform its market-beta-adjusted expectation over the next 1-5 days after the shock, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Rate spike compresses REIT dividend yield spread
mechanism: A sudden increase in the 10-year Treasury yield makes REIT dividend yields relatively less attractive, prompting investors to rotate out of rate-sensitive REITs, especially those with high payout ratios and low growth.
precursor: Daily change in ^TNX exceeds 2 standard deviations of its trailing 60-day volatility.
separation_from_beta: Compare REIT basket return to a duration-matched bond proxy and to the broad market, isolating the rate sensitivity beyond equity beta.
refutation: If the REIT basket does not underperform its beta-adjusted expectation and shows no significant negative abnormal return relative to utilities (another rate-sensitive sector) after the yield spike, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Guidance cut by bellwether triggers supplier sell-off
mechanism: When a sector bellwether cuts guidance due to weak demand, its suppliers experience negative read-through as investors anticipate order reductions, but the effect is delayed for smaller suppliers with less analyst coverage.
precursor: A bellwether firm issues a guidance cut citing demand weakness, with a stock price drop >5% on the day, before market close.
separation_from_beta: Compare supplier basket return to a matched set of firms in the same industry with no supply relationship, controlling for market beta and sector return.
refutation: If linked suppliers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to unlinked industry peers over the next 3 sessions, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Oil price shock lifts energy sector but drags transports
mechanism: A sharp oil price increase boosts energy sector earnings expectations but raises fuel costs for transportation firms, leading to divergent returns that may not be fully reflected in sector ETFs due to slow rebalancing.
precursor: Daily change in CL=F exceeds 2 standard deviations of its trailing 60-day volatility.
separation_from_beta: Compare the spread between energy and transport sector returns to their historical beta-adjusted spread, and to the broad market.
refutation: If the energy-transport return spread does not widen significantly beyond its historical beta-adjusted expectation over the next 5 days, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Clinical trial failure of one firm drags peers with similar pipeline
mechanism: When a biotech firm announces a failed clinical trial for a drug in a specific therapeutic area, investors reassess the probability of success for competitor drugs in the same area, leading to negative read-through for peers with similar pipeline assets.
precursor: A biotech firm announces a Phase 2/3 clinical trial failure with detailed results, before market open.
separation_from_beta: Compare peer basket return to a matched set of biotech firms with no pipeline overlap in that therapeutic area, controlling for market beta and sector return.
refutation: If linked peers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to unlinked biotech firms over the next 2 sessions, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Equity issuance dilution signals overvaluation, peers follow
mechanism: When a firm announces a secondary equity offering, it may signal that management believes shares are overvalued, leading investors to question valuations of similar firms and sell them off.
precursor: A firm announces a secondary equity offering with a discount to current price, before market open.
separation_from_beta: Compare peer basket return to a matched set of firms in the same sector with no recent equity issuance, controlling for market beta and sector return.
refutation: If linked peers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to unlinked sector peers over the next 2 sessions, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Tone agreement in news predicts larger next-session move
mechanism: When multiple news articles about a stock agree in tone (all positive or all negative), it signals consensus information that reduces uncertainty, leading to a larger price impact as investors act on the news.
precursor: For a given stock, the proportion of positive-sentiment articles among all articles on day t exceeds 80% or is below 20%, based on a pre-trained sentiment model.
separation_from_beta: Compare the absolute next-session return of stocks with high tone agreement to those with low agreement, controlling for trailing volatility and market return.
refutation: If high tone agreement does not predict a significantly larger absolute next-session return after controlling for trailing volatility and market beta, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Size attention to earnings
mechanism: Highly-attended earnings reports can boost company stocks for days.
precursor: A company's attention score spikes before earnings announcement.
separation_from_beta: The stock's next-day return exceeds its market beta by more than 2 standard deviations.
refutation: The stock's return is within 1 standard deviation of market beta after the next trading day.

title: Event readthrough via news co-mentions
mechanism: Companies frequently mentioned in the same news articles can experience synchronized market reactions.
precursor: A company experiences a large market reaction to a news event.
separation_from_beta: Linked companies show a return increase beyond their own volatility in the next trading session.
refutation: Linked companies do not show a return increase beyond their own volatility in the next trading session.

title: Macro lead-lag effect on commodity prices
mechanism: Commodity prices can lead or lag macroeconomic indicators like interest rates.
precursor: A macroeconomic indicator like interest rates shows a significant change.
separation_from_beta: Commodity stocks move in the expected direction beyond their market beta within 5 trading days.
refutation: Commodity stocks do not move in the expected direction beyond their market beta within 5 trading days.

title: Supply chain disruptions affecting small caps
mechanism: Supply chain disruptions can disproportionately affect smaller companies.
precursor: A major supplier experiences a significant supply chain disruption.
separation_from_beta: Small-cap stocks move more than their market beta in the expected direction within 3 trading days.
refutation: Small-cap stocks do not move more than their market beta in the expected direction within 3 trading days.

title: Volatility compression post-earnings
mechanism: Earnings reports can compress future volatility expectations.
precursor: A company's earnings report shows a positive surprise.
separation_from_beta: The stock's next-day return is above the market beta, with a decrease in implied volatility.
refutation: The stock's return is below the market beta, with an increase in implied volatility after the next trading day.

title: Event readthrough via peer correlations
mechanism: Peer companies can experience similar market reactions due to shared factors.
precursor: A company in a specific industry experiences a large market reaction to a news event.
separation_from_beta: Peer companies in the same industry show a return increase beyond their own volatility in the next trading session.
refutation: Peer companies do not show a return increase beyond their own volatility in the next trading session.

title: Size effect on analyst downgrades
mechanism: Analyst downgrades can have a larger impact on smaller companies.
precursor: An analyst downgrades a small-cap company's rating.
separation_from_beta: The stock's return is below its market beta and volatility increases in the next trading session.
refutation: The stock's return is above its market beta and volatility does not increase in the next trading session.

title: Macro lead-lag effect on interest rates
mechanism: Interest rate changes can lead or lag macroeconomic indicators like GDP growth.
precursor: A macroeconomic indicator like GDP growth shows a significant change.
separation_from_beta: Stocks in the financial sector show a return increase beyond their market beta within 5 trading days.
refutation: Financial stocks do not show a return increase beyond their market beta within 5 trading days.

title: Earnings and guidance cells as a straddle-sizing multiplier
mechanism: Earnings (+0.29 log ratio 2025, +0.22 2026, every month) and guidance (+0.37/+0.17) move more than trailing vol predicts; an implied-move comparison should price that, or it is an options edge.

title: Supplier earnings miss hits customer next session
mechanism: A key supplier's earnings miss signals cost pressure or demand weakness that will show up in the customer's margins, so the customer's stock drifts down the next session as investors connect the dots.
precursor: Supplier (co-mentioned in prior news as a supplier) reports earnings miss with >2 sd reaction at close t.
separation_from_beta: Compare customer's next-session return to its own market-beta-adjusted return and to vol-matched non-linked peers; the effect should be present only for names with a pre-existing supplier link.
refutation: If linked customers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Customer guidance cut drags suppliers next session
mechanism: A major customer's guidance cut implies lower future orders, so its suppliers' stocks fall the next session as investors anticipate revenue shortfalls.
precursor: Customer (co-mentioned as customer in prior news) issues guidance cut with >2 sd reaction at close t.
separation_from_beta: Compare supplier's next-session return to its own market-beta-adjusted return and to vol-matched non-linked peers; effect should be absent for non-linked peers.
refutation: If linked suppliers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Regulatory approval for one firm lifts co-mentioned peers
mechanism: A regulatory approval for a drug or product in a therapeutic area signals a favorable regulatory environment, so co-mentioned peers in the same area rally the next session.
precursor: Source firm receives regulatory approval with >2 sd reaction at close t; peers co-mentioned in prior news about the same area.
separation_from_beta: Compare peers' next-session return to their own market-beta-adjusted return and to vol-matched non-linked peers; effect should be present only for co-mentioned peers.
refutation: If co-mentioned peers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Clinical trial success lifts correlation peers next session
mechanism: A positive clinical trial result for one biotech increases the probability of success for similar drugs, so correlation peers with similar pipelines rise the next session.
precursor: Source biotech reports positive clinical trial result with >2 sd reaction at close t; peers with high return correlation in prior 60 days.
separation_from_beta: Compare peers' next-session return to their own market-beta-adjusted return and to vol-matched non-linked peers; effect should be present only for high-correlation peers.
refutation: If high-correlation peers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Equity issuance by peer predicts dilution fears next session
mechanism: When a firm announces an equity issuance, investors infer that its close peers may also need capital, so peers' stocks decline the next session on dilution fears.
precursor: Source firm announces equity issuance with >2 sd reaction at close t; peers co-mentioned in prior news about financing or same sector.
separation_from_beta: Compare peers' next-session return to their own market-beta-adjusted return and to vol-matched non-linked peers; effect should be present only for co-mentioned peers.
refutation: If co-mentioned peers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Oil shock lifts tanker stocks next session
mechanism: A sharp oil price increase raises demand for tanker shipping as producers and traders move oil to capture higher prices, so tanker stocks rise the next session.
precursor: Crude oil futures (CL=F) daily change >= 2 sd at close t.
separation_from_beta: Compare tanker basket's next-session return to its market-beta-adjusted return and to a vol-matched basket of other transports; effect should be present only for tankers.
refutation: If tanker basket shows no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched transports, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Yield spike lifts money-center banks next session
mechanism: A sharp rise in the 10-year Treasury yield steepens the yield curve, improving net interest margins for money-center banks, so their stocks rise the next session.
precursor: 10-year Treasury yield (^TNX) daily change >= 2 sd at close t.
separation_from_beta: Compare money-center bank basket's next-session return to its market-beta-adjusted return and to a vol-matched basket of utilities; effect should be present only for banks.
refutation: If money-center bank basket shows no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched utilities, the hypothesis is refuted.

title: Abnormal attention increases move size beyond volatility
mechanism: Stocks with abnormally high news attention attract more traders, leading to larger price moves the next session even after controlling for trailing volatility and text content.
precursor: Abnormal news attention (article count z-score) > 2 at close t.
separation_from_beta: Compare next-session absolute return to trailing volatility and TF-IDF text model; effect should be present only for high-attention stocks.
refutation: If abnormal attention does not add rank IC for next-session move size over trailing volatility and TF-IDF, the hypothesis is refuted.

separation_from_beta: Compare high-fuel-exposure airlines to low-exposure airlines matched on size and beta; the high-minus-low residual spread should be negative.
refutation: If high-fuel-exposure airlines' beta-adjusted residual at t+1 is not more negative than low-exposure peers (spread >= 0, t < 1.5), refuted.

mechanism: A regulatory approval for one firm signals pipeline/approval probability for co-mentioned peers in the same therapeutic class, so co-mentioned names drift up next session beyond their own volatility.
precursor: Source firm has a large positive reaction (|z|>=2) to a regulatory_approval event; peers co-mentioned with source in prior 90-day news.

title: Guidance-cut read-through to correlation peers
mechanism: A guidance cut reveals demand weakness that is common across correlated peers, so correlation peers drift down next session beyond their own volatility and market beta.
precursor: Source firm has a large negative reaction (|z|>=2) to a guidance_change event; peers identified by trailing 60-day return correlation.
separation_from_beta: Compare correlation peers to vol-matched uncorrelated names in the same sector; the peer-minus-control residual spread should be negative.
refutation: If correlation peers' next-session residual is not more negative than vol-matched uncorrelated peers (spread >= 0, t < 1), refuted.

title: Equity issuance dilution read-through to cash-poor peers
mechanism: An equity issuance by one firm signals funding stress in the sector; cash-poor peers with similar burn rates face higher dilution risk, so their next-session residual return is negative.
precursor: Source firm announces equity_issuance_dilution with large negative reaction; peers with low cash runway (quarters of cash) in same sub-industry.
separation_from_beta: Compare cash-poor peers to cash-rich peers matched on size and beta; the cash-poor-minus-cash-rich residual spread should be negative.
refutation: If cash-poor peers' next-session residual is not more negative than cash-rich matched peers (spread >= 0, t < 1), refuted.

title: Tone disagreement adds to size rank IC
mechanism: When news tone across sources disagrees on a name, uncertainty about fundamentals is higher, so the next-session move size is larger than trailing volatility and TF-IDF alone predict.
precursor: Cell-level tone_agreement feature computed from multi-source news before the open; high disagreement score.

title: Quality / cash-lowvol / ope_be / revision flow as investable spreads (hedged, short-twin, size-hedged, top-500 overlay)
mechanism: Relative edges over a matched twin are capturable by shorting the comparison leg or hedging beta/size
precursor: rule picks at month-end d from point-in-time fundamentals and IBES flow; hedge ratios from months before d
separation_from_beta: beta-hedged and band-index-hedged variants remove market and size exposure
refutation: validate 2009-2016 spread <= 0 or t < 2 or a minority of positive years, net of spread and borrow

title: Volatility-managed market exposure driven by the size forecast (rv, HAR, HAR + earnings-season intensity)
mechanism: Better next-period volatility forecasts raise log utility of a vol-targeted market position
precursor: realised variance and the market value expected to report earnings in the hold window, known at d
separation_from_beta: compared with buy-and-hold at the SAME average exposure and at matched realised vol
refutation: validate log-utility difference <= 0 or t < 2

title: Insider cluster buys (>=3 officer/director buyers in 30 days) entered at the next open after the filing
mechanism: Insiders buying together know something the price does not; the drift is front-loaded after the public filing
precursor: Form 4 filings public by the end of day D; entry at the open of D+1
separation_from_beta: abnormal vs the market AND vs an equal-weight same-size-band benchmark
refutation: net of a round trip, validate mean <= 0 or t < 2 vs the same-band benchmark

title: Part of quality_composite / cash_lowvol's twin t is restated (current-vintage) data
mechanism: Compustat current vintage embeds restatements an investor could not see
precursor: SEC first-reported vs latest-reported annual facts, both timed at the first filing + 2 days
separation_from_beta: paired on identical names and months
refutation: first-minus-latest rule-twin difference within its MDE

title: Insider cluster drift captured by passive execution (limit orders inside the spread)
mechanism: The post-filing insider drift (+1.1-1.5% gross over 5 sessions) equals the round trip in small names; paying half the spread or earning it could leave a net
precursor: the same public-date cluster; order placed at the open of D+1 as a limit at the prior close/mid
separation_from_beta: same-band equal-weight benchmark; fill probability measured, not assumed
refutation: forward paper fills: net of realised fill cost and missed fills, 5-session abnormal <= 0
notes: found after looking at the aggregate; needs a paper execution log, not a backtest

title: House PTR purchases entered after disclosure (TRIAL-CONGRESS-PTR-FWD-1)
mechanism: Members' purchases carry information not priced by the disclosure date
precursor: PTR disclosure date 23:59 ET; entry at the next open
separation_from_beta: market-adjusted, one event per member-ticker per 30 days
refutation: decision read 2028-04-01: t <= 0, or NOT_DETECTABLE if the MDE stays above 0.5pp
notes: registered UNPOWERED_AT_REGISTRATION; accrual only; first read 2027-04-01

title: Vol-managed market exposure for the preservation personality: drawdown-constrained utility, not log utility
mechanism: At equal average exposure the vol-targeted market cut max drawdown (-33% vs -54% 1991-2024, -16% vs -25% 2009-16) at about equal terminal wealth
precursor: realised variance known at d
separation_from_beta: equal average exposure and matched realised vol benchmarks
refutation: under a declared drawdown-penalised utility (e.g. CRRA 4 or a -20% drawdown cap), the vol-managed path is not better than buy-and-hold at equal exposure in 2009-2024
notes: declare the utility BEFORE reading; the 2009-2024 paths are already seen for log utility

title: Tanker rates read through to refiners' crude sourcing cost
mechanism: When tanker freight spikes, refiners with heavy waterborne crude intake see input cost pressure and margin squeeze, depressing their shares with a one-day lag as desks update models.
precursor: Baltic Dirty Tanker Index or FRO/STNG/DHT basket jump >= 2 sd at close t.
separation_from_beta: Effect persists after hedging XLE and SPY; only refiners with high import share (VLO, PBF, DINO) react, not domestic-heavy ones.
refutation: Refiner basket open-to-close t+1 move is indistinguishable from XLE-hedged control after a tanker shock.

title: Guidance cut at a supplier drags its disclosed customers
mechanism: A supplier guiding down signals weakening end-demand for its named customers, and co-mentioned customer names get re-rated the next session before sell-side notes land.
precursor: Supplier earnings/guidance event with |reaction| >= 3 sd and at least 3 co-mentioned customer tickers in prior 90-day news.
separation_from_beta: Linked customers move more than their own vol-matched sector peers with no co-mention link to the source.
refutation: Co-mentioned customers' next-session abnormal return is statistically indistinguishable from vol-matched unlinked peers.

title: Correlation-peer spillover after a clinical trial miss
mechanism: A Phase 3 miss at one biotech raises perceived class-wide regulatory or mechanism risk, dragging return-correlation peers the next session before idiosyncratic data is parsed.
precursor: Source biotech moves >= 4 sd on clinical_trial_result with negative sign; peers identified by 60-day return correlation >= 0.5.
separation_from_beta: Peer move exceeds XBI-hedged expectation and is larger for peers sharing the same mechanism/target keyword in filings.
refutation: Correlation peers' XBI-hedged next-session return is zero or positive after the source miss.

title: 10Y yield shock hits unprofitable small caps next open
mechanism: A sharp 10Y jump raises the discount rate most for long-duration cash flows, so unprofitable small caps underperform from t+1 open to close before the effect broadens.
precursor: TNX daily change >= 2 sd at close t.
separation_from_beta: Effect is concentrated in unprofitable small caps vs profitable small caps, and survives IWM hedge.
refutation: Unprofitable small-cap basket IWM-hedged t+1 return shows no negative tilt after TNX shocks.

title: Crude spike lifts integrated majors over E&Ps
mechanism: A crude shock improves integrated majors' upstream realizations without the same hedging/discount drag E&Ps face, so XOM/CVX outperform a pure-play E&P basket the next session.
precursor: CL=F daily change >= 2 sd at close t.
separation_from_beta: Long XOM/CVX vs short FANG,OXY,DVN spread is positive after crude shocks; both legs share energy beta so XLE-hedge nets it out.
refutation: Integrated-vs-EP relative return from t+1 open to close shows no positive response to crude shocks.

title: Equity issuance dilution readthrough to correlated peers
mechanism: A dilutive equity raise signals sector funding stress; return-correlation peers with similar cash-burn profiles sell off next session as investors extrapolate refinancing risk.
precursor: Source name announces equity_issuance_dilution and drops >= 3 sd; peers = 60-day return correlation >= 0.5.
separation_from_beta: Peer underperformance is larger for high-cash-burn peers than low-burn peers in the same sector, net of sector ETF.
refutation: Correlation peers' sector-hedged next-session return is zero after the dilution event.

title: Abnormal attention increment on size of next-day move
mechanism: Names with abnormal news attention (vs trailing 60-day baseline) attract more order flow at the open, enlarging the realized size of the next-session move beyond volatility and TF-IDF tone.
precursor: Overnight news count for the ticker exceeds its 60-day mean by >= 2 sd.
separation_from_beta: Rank IC of abn_attention for |t+1 return| survives controls for trailing vol and TF-IDF text score.
refutation: Adding abn_attention to the size model yields rank IC increment <= 0 in the confirm fold.

title: Event-prior feature increment on next-session size
mechanism: Knowing a scheduled event type (earnings, FDA date, lockup expiry) shifts the conditional distribution of next-session move size; an event-prior feature should add rank IC over trailing vol and text.
precursor: Calendar flag for a scheduled event within the next session for the ticker.
separation_from_beta: Rank IC increment for |t+1 return| from event_prior remains positive after vol and TF-IDF controls.
refutation: event_prior adds no rank IC to the size model in the confirm fold.
